about_the_game:
Key features in the game:

  • Traveling in a camper van

  • Relaxing natural atmosphere

  • Carrying/arranging cargo, furniture, and in-game items

  • Transporting goods between camps and towns

  • Traveling by watercraft, including with cargo

  • Rafting, hidden paths, and cave exploration

  • Cooking using kitchen and camping equipment

  • Crafting at special workstations

  • Creating your own campsite

  • Decorating

  • Fishing

  • Collecting mushrooms, plants, and other consumables

Your journey begins today!

Explore an open world in your camper van as a Sherpa driver, helping friends and tourists on adventures through picturesque landscapes!

Deliver parcels and cargo along mountain roads

Transport goods in your van across winding mountain paths between camps, and immerse yourself in the atmosphere of adventure in a handcrafted world.

Craft and cook food and coffee for adventurers!

Adventurers you meet along the way need help, supplies, and meals! Haul equipment and materials in your van to craft and cook for them.

Water transportation

Use boats, kayaks, and paddleboards to deliver cargo to islands and hard-to-reach areas inaccessible by land.

Explore mountains, rivers, lakes, and forests

Trek narrow trails and dive into water in search of hidden spots, caves, and secrets.

Earn, buy, and sell

Complete quests in camps and towns to earn money for new opportunities, goods, and van upgrades in the game world!

Get inspired by the atmosphere of hiking and mountain adventures in a handcrafted world

10x10 km² of stunning mountains, lakes, rivers, and forests, inspired by the landscapes of the Himalayas, Switzerland, Norway, Italy, and Georgia.

Reunite with old friends!

Your old friends live in the game world, and they’ll be happy to see you, ask for your help, and share stories together!

Indie next-gen

Expect realistic and cozy gameplay scenes with complex lighting setups, beautiful graphics, and advanced physics simulation systems.

About me and the studio

I’m a solo developer with 15 years of programming experience. I've taken on the ambitious challenge of optimizing an open world in Unreal Engine 5 by properly using Lumen, Nanite, Ray Tracing and complexity physics.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3, 4 cores
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Desktop RTX 3060, 8gb VRAM
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7, 8 cores
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Desktop RTX 4070, 8gb VRAM
  • Storage: 20 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any

short_description: 🏔 🚐 ⛺️ 📦 🍳 🛶 Explore a cozy open world as a sherpa driver in your van! Deliver cargo, cook food, craft gear, and explore mountains, lakes, and hidden trails. Sail in boats and kayaks, dive underwater. Meet old friends and upgrade your van! A camping atmosphere and next-gen graphics
